description: Comprehensive guide to WIP schedules including schedule preparation, job-by-job analysis, variance reporting, over/under billing reconciliation, and management/lender reporting requirements.

sections.title: WIP Schedule Fundamentals
sections.content:
The Work-in-Progress (WIP) schedule is the single most important management and financial reporting tool for construction contractors. It provides a comprehensive snapshot of all active contracts, showing contract values, costs incurred, revenue recognized, billings, and over/under billing positions.

WIP schedules serve multiple critical purposes:
- Management decision-making and project monitoring
- Financial statement preparation
- Bank and surety reporting
- Performance evaluation
- Early problem detection
